terms.comment: Our everyday choice for a project being carried out. Plural opera, operum n. pl. Recovered from our 24 September 2026 discussion: both words were proposed, and Jack used Opus incipiāmus. These are contextual choices, not a claim that either word always corresponds to every English use of “project.”
Useful when the planned undertaking is the focus.

sources: Lewis & Short: opus · Lewis & Short: consilium. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
